description: A Leading Voice Representative Allison Russo has served four terms in, and is the former Minority Leader of, the Ohio House of Representatives, protecting one person one vote, advocating for reproductive rights, and fighting for labor protections. The first Democrat in a decade to flip a central-Ohio seat, and one of the state’s leading voices […]
